articles.title: Bitcoin plunges below $59,000 as rush to cash puts new bear market lows back in play
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is closing in on its $57,700 summer low as Delphi Digital strategist warns the Fed could make matters worse and STS Digital sees cash as the place to hide.

articles.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
articles.snippet: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.
